title: Hearth extension dimensions.
officialText:
Hearth extensions shall extend at least 16 inches (406 mm) in front of, and at least 8
inches (203 mm) beyond, each side of the fireplace opening. Where the fireplace opening is 6 square feet (0.56 m2) or larger, the
hearth extension shall extend at least 20 inches (508 mm) in front of, and at least 12 inches (305 mm) beyond, each side of the
fireplace opening.
